name: PdxButtonGroup
description:
Groups action buttons visually, and passes variant, size and disabled on to its buttons. To select
among buttons, use `pdx-toggle-group`.

members.name: size
members.description: Size of the control (e.g. sm, md, lg).

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: label
members.description: The group's accessible name ("Text alignment"), set as `aria-label` on the group.
